Badlands.description: Hardened by extreme temperatures and blistering winds in dry badlands.

features.name: Badlands Orc
features.tldr: You gain resistance to fire and navigate rough terrain without penalty.

Winter.description: Tough survivors who endure freezing mountain peaks and snowstorms.

features.name: Winter Orc
features.tldr: You gain resistance to cold and ignore environmental ice movement penalties.
